parsed.why: Decriminalised with anti-discrimination and hate-crime laws and protected Pride, but recent unsanctioned police assault on LGBT people, repeated unpunished attacks on an LGBT centre, and hostile majority attitudes leave thin practical recourse.

Article 521 jailing 'men disguising as women' reaches trans visitors; no legal recognition, documented arrests, anal examinations and an executive assembly ban. Judicial pushback on the sodomy article and a frozen order soften this only slightly.

2024 decriminalisation is a real positive and no trans-specific offence or targeting is documented, but no protections exist, police dismissed victims, and slurs, a killing and anti-gay tourist rhetoric show a hostile society with thin recourse.

Forced examinations and police named foremost LGBTI rights violators — officially acknowledged — with vagrancy/personation exposure and birth-sex prison default; offset by supportive officials, tolerant poll majorities and longstanding community organisations.

Airport anatomy screening, refusal and deportation of trans visitors across a decade, a presentation offence jailing visitors, degraded detention with head-shaving and hormone confiscation: state-imposed universal exposure with no working remedy.
